svg.text: Table cards show descriptions and typed keys. Relationship IDs on the lines match the purpose and cardinality list below the diagram.
Primary key · Foreign key · Unique key. auto = integer identity; big_auto = bigint identity; uuid = UUID.
Cardinality is listed per relationship: parents per child and children per parent. Repeated Employee / User cards are shared references, not extra tables.
Shared reference: employee and account cards repeat in the related domain views.
Junction tables connect users or groups to the permissions they receive.
The employee card is a reference to the same core_employee table.
One employee can have multiple requests and records; nullable links are marked in the keys.
ClaimStatus and Message have no foreign-key connection in the current model.
